$comment: The mini-site's machine-readable description of itself. The oracle-packs plugin's listing and demo skills read it before they edit, check, preview or publish this site. Change it in the same commit as the thing it describes. Prose rules live in docs/START-HERE.md; enforcement lives in tools/check-grammar.js.
name: Oracle AI & Data Solutions

contract.$comment: Bump in any round that changes a content.js key, a config switch, a product tab, a checker rule or a publish rule. The plugin compares this with the round its own listing references were written against and defers to the site when the site is newer.

paths.$linksComment: Round 15: links.json is the only file that stores a link, keyed by the product slug (= the listing's slug = the pack's slug: = site/demo/<slug>/). data/links.js is never a file under site/: tools/serve.py answers it from links.json, and a publish builds it with buildSiteLinks into siteLinks and maps data/links.js to that file.

publish.fullTree: Every path the target's list_files already shows, plus the new files: since round 12 that includes data/links.js, without which every Interactive demo button disappears — since round 15 built for each publish by paths.buildSiteLinks and mapped from paths.siteLinks, never from site/ — since round 14 assets/img/softserve-star-white.svg, the footer's spark, and since round 18 assets/img/bands/* (the Bespoke band's two crops, replaced in §57) and assets/img/groups/ask.svg (the catalog's last tile), and since 2026-09-29 (PROVENANCE §53) assets/img/brand/softserve-logo-white.svg, the About tile's logo, and since §54 assets/img/heroes/products.jpg, the catalog's hero, and since §55 assets/img/posters/*, the stills in the product heroes' frames (every product with a walkthrough or a recording needs its poster on the artifact); round 18 also removes pages/services.js from the artifact by mapping it to null, since files left out of a publish are kept, and version 1790678606-4e27 (2026-09-29) removed data/review.js and assets/review.js, the Internal panel, the same way, and version 1790702708-a5ce (round 22, PROVENANCE §58) data/diagrams.js, the SVG diagrams the Technology tab's HTML strip replaced. Never the whole folder: the archived theme's files stay off this artifact.
publish.demoTargets: links.json: products[<slug>].interactiveDemoArtifact (round 12; config.js carries no link to a kit artifact). Nothing copies it (round 15): the next publish builds data/links.js from links.json

sweep.patterns: every name on the practice deny-list, plus logos/
